summary: The small two-position switch in the navigation that flips the site between calm and nerd mode.
purpose: Gives visitors a visible control for the mode.
why: Lets people choose the wording and look they prefer.
how: Draws a pill-shaped button with two labels and a sliding highlight under the active one. Its accessible label names the mode the button will switch to.
inputs: The current mode and the toggle function from the mode context.
outputs: A clickable button that switches the mode.
risks: The highlight position depends on fixed size values, so resizing the button needs those values adjusted too. Outside the provider, clicks do nothing.
debug: If the switch does not move, check the current mode and the highlight classes. If clicks do nothing, check that the component sits inside the provider.
